title: health/iosxe/YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SSZ.json
description: IOS-XE lab slip (Kind observation). Written on the first visit, when something material moved against health/metadata-iosxe.json current[], or when coverage is not complete. metrics are per-device counts. readings are only the rows that moved or are abnormal this visit; the first visit writes every row and becomes baseline_ref. unchanged counts the board rows not in readings. vs_prior.changed is structured: one item per field that moved. relations lists edges new this visit. No RESTCONF body.

headline.description: Quotes measurements: which subject, which field, prior -> current.

concerns.description: One device entity-ref when a metric on that device is non-zero. Omit healthy devices.

readings.description: First visit: every admin-up interface, every BGP neighbor, every ACL (and one acl row with present false per device that returned 204). Later visits: only rows whose material field moved since current[], plus rows that are abnormal now (oper not ready, BGP not established, errors/discards/flaps increased). Not the whole estate.

unchanged.description: Count of board rows (metadata current[]) that are not in readings. 0 on the first visit. null when coverage is unavailable.

baseline_ref.description: health/iosxe/<baseline_visit_id>.json — the first-visit stamp that listed every subject. Null on the first visit itself.

relations.description: Observed edges that are new this visit (a neighbor that appeared, a BGP peer that resolved for the first time). The full current edge set is on metadata relations[].

entity_ref.description: workspace-handoff entity reference. Do not copy the referenced object. Do not invent id.

vs_prior.description: Diff of this collection against metadata current[]. First visit: prior_watch_id null, delta first, changed []. Later visits: one changed item per material field that moved.

prior_watch_id.description: metadata last_visit_id at the start of this visit.

delta.description: worse when any change lowered health (state left up/established, counters increased, ACL unbound). better when every change raised it. changed when it is neither (new neighbor, ACL bound, first ACE hits).

prior.description: Prior value from current[]; null when the row is new (field row).

current.description: Value this visit; null when the row disappeared (field row).

at.description: Interface last-change from the device when the field is oper or admin; otherwise this visit's checked_at.

acls.description: ACLs present on the device. 0 when the ACL GET returned 204. null when not collected.

keys.description: Same keys as the matching current[] row.

name.description: Device name as inventory/prod.json writes it.

subject.description: Interface name as the device reports it, the BGP neighbor id, or the ACL name (none when present is false).

note.description: Nurse's opinion for the higher agent: what this row shows and, after the first visit, what moved and since when. A sentence that only says unchanged is not a note.
